issue: dns-tunnel entries fall through to BuildVlessOutbound (targets the domain with Reality/TLS) instead of getting an UnsupportedByVerifier gate like AWG (line 226), xhttp (line 232), and naive (line 250) — deep-verify always false-fails with a misleading error because the real config (ConfigGenerator.cs:1563) targets 127.0.0.1:7001 with no TLS
fix: Add a dns-tunnel gate in VerifyAsync before the IsAvailable check (mirroring the naive gate at line 250): if protocol is "dns-tunnel", return DeepVerifyResult.Failed("dns-tunnel needs the slipstream-client sidecar", DeepVerifyFailurePhase.UnsupportedByVerifier). The slipstream sidecar cannot run inside the verifier's ephemeral sing-box spawn, so dns-tunnel is inherently untestable here — same pattern as the AWG/xhttp/naive gates.
